missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Половина' is feminine nominative as the subject of 'готова'. 'Работы' is the genitive showing what half it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Половину' is the feminine accusative direct object of 'съел'. 'Яблока' is the genitive marking the whole.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity word. 'Половины' is the feminine genitive after 'больше'. 'Людей' is a second genitive naming the whole group.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Половину' is the feminine accusative object of 'отдал'. 'Зарплаты' is genitive, and 'семье' is the dative recipient.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Половиной' is the instrumental form after 'довольны', which governs the instrumental. 'Второй' agrees in the feminine instrumental.

missions.phrase: В первой половине дня было тихо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В половине' uses the prepositional form after 'в'. 'Первой' agrees in the feminine, and 'дня' is the genitive whole.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in time idiom. 'В половине' uses the prepositional form to tell time, meaning at half past five. A practical everyday pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Половины' is the nominative plural as the subject. 'Обе' and 'светлые' agree in the plural, describing both halves.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Половины' is the feminine genitive after 'без'. 'Второй' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Половина' is feminine nominative as the subject of the price question. 'Торта' is the genitive marking the whole cake.
